1. **Why:** Help operators catch CSV import mistakes before committing durable rows. ([design.md, Context](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/design.md:2))

2. **Representative case:** A three-row CSV containing one invalid row produces counts of two valid and one invalid, writing zero rows. ([design.md:5](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/design.md:5))

3. **Current increment:** Deliver preview only, accepted by Mira on 2026-09-01. Columns must remain `id,name`; accepting them is complete, while returning valid/invalid counts remains unfinished. Operators may download diagnostics. Enabling preview requires the support owner’s approval of the sample-file walkthrough. ([design.md, Decision and Deployment gate](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/design.md:8); [tasks.md, Task 1](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/tasks.md:2))

4. **Outside it:** Applying imported rows remains future work and disabled. Diagnostics do not authorize applying rows. The pending Apply task depends on Preview. ([design.md:10](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/design.md:10); [tasks.md, Task 2](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/tasks.md:8))

5. **Remaining decision:** Product must decide duplicate-row policy before Apply is implemented. Whether the support owner has approved preview enablement is unspecified. ([tasks.md:11](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/tasks.md:11); [design.md, Deployment gate](/home/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-docs/verification/task4-20260929/local/cross-file-preservation/original/design.md:11))
